description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_EntityParser, which handles referencing and dereferencing character entities in HTML documents, including methods for substituting entities in text and attribute contexts, along with related callback functions and internal regex patterns.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_EntityParser
classes.description: Class for handling referencing and dereferencing of HTML character entities, providing methods to substitute entities in text and attributes, and managing internal regex patterns and lookup tables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes regex patterns for parsing named and numeric entities, both in text and attribute contexts.

methods.name: substituteTextEntities
methods.description: Replaces character entities in HTML text content with their Unicode equivalents.

methods.name: substituteAttrEntities
methods.description: Replaces character entities within HTML attribute values with their Unicode equivalents.

methods.name: entityCallback
methods.description: Callback that processes matched entities, converting hexadecimal and decimal numeric entities, or looking up named entities.

methods.name: substituteNonSpecialEntities
methods.description: Replaces non-special character entities with their Unicode equivalents, avoiding the big five HTML entities.

methods.name: nonSpecialEntityCallback
methods.description: Callback that processes non-special entities, converting numeric entities, or resolving named entities via lookup.

methods.name: substituteSpecialEntities
methods.description: Replaces only the 'big five' special entities (", &, <, >, ') with their Unicode characters.

methods.name: specialEntityCallback
methods.description: Callback that converts special numeric or named entities into their Unicode characters.
